verdict.rationale: Docs confirm multi-provider TTS support (Deepgram, Azure, ElevenLabs, and more) plus configurable voices/accents/speaking styles and a central integrations settings page for connecting providers, directly matching the story's plug-in-multiple-providers aspect. However, there's no evidence of a 'broad voice library' with browsable catalog of preset voices, voice counts, or sample previews — missing for 10: evidence of a built-in voice library/catalog with selectable presets, independent/hands-on confirmation of TTS provider integration quality, and details on voice customization depth (e.g., cloning, style controls).
